title: Cap Set Problem
exact_target: Find the largest subset of each n-dimensional affine space over the three-element field containing no three distinct collinear points, and determine its growth with dimension.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1364 (GAME-007). CC BY 4.0.
